newsitem.title: INDIA: ANZ unit named advisor to Indian power project.
newsitem.headline: ANZ unit named advisor to Indian power project.

text.p: ANZ Investment Bank (ANZIB) has been appointed financial advisor to a power project in the northern Indian state of Rajasthan, the bank said on Wednesday.

The project, a 700 megawatt dual fuel fired combined power project, is sponsored by the private sector RPG Enterprises and will be known as the RPG Dholpur Power Company Ltd, the bank said in a statement.
The Dholpur power plant will be based on the environmentally friendly naphtha based combined cycle technology, with an option to switch to natural gas at a later date, the statement said.
It gave no details on the financial aspects of the project.
